cover.title: A page with steps
cover.overview: Write a how-to with a title, a bit of context, numbered steps, and a result. Not a story.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled mock if the app cannot open.

objectives.text: Write a how-to with a title, a bit of context, numbered steps, and a result. Not a story
Carry out the lab: Change the water
Choose the right answer for: A how-to page (a task) should hold…

blocks.body: Write a how-to with a title, a bit of context, numbered steps, and a result. Not a story.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: How to do it
blocks.body:
Oxygen calls this a **task**. It is a how-to.

- A little **context** (when / who)
- **Steps** (the real step list, not a numbered paragraph)
- A **result** (what “done” looks like)

Do not tell the history of vases here. Yesterday’s page already did “what it is.”

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Task** :  a page of numbered steps a person can follow.

cards.back: a page of numbered steps a person can follow

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Steps are a fake numbered paragraph, or there are no steps, or you used a Concept template.

Expected: A task file with real steps and a result. Clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: File > New > DITA Task. Title: Change the water. File: oxygen-bootcamp-work/week2/change-the-water.dita.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: In the context line (if the template has one), say when to do this: every two days, or when the water is cloudy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Add three steps in the step list, not as a numbered list inside a paragraph: recut the stems, empty the vase, refill with cool water.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Add a result line: the water is clear and the stems are recut.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not explain the history of vases. That belongs on an explaining page.

blocks.summary: A task file with real steps and a result. Clean.

blocks.q: A how-to page (a task) should hold…
options: Numbered steps a person can do, plus a result
blocks.why: A task is a procedure. History is a concept. A price table is a lookup page.

blocks.q: Why not type 1. 2. 3. inside a normal paragraph?
options: It looks the same, so it is fine
The app has real steps. Fake numbers in a paragraph will not behave like steps later
blocks.why: Use the step list from the task template. That is the apple today.
